text:
marta: heads up — planning maintenance in az15 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. rolling node reboots + nic firmware patch. expected transient capacity drop ~10% in az15. will route traffic to az12/az2. need canary + backfill sign-off. @sam @jorge :wave:

sam: timeline? any chance we shift earlier to avoid payroll batch?

marta: looked at it — payroll batch is 00:30-01:15 UTC for az15, so moving earlier risks interfering. prefer 02:00 start, 2 racks at a time, 15m stabilization between racks.

jorge: plan I'll run canary on pool-gradient-az15-1 then promote. steps: cordon -> drain -> reboot -> verify nvlink + egress -> uncordon.
```
# drain example
kubectl cordon node/gpu-az15-03
kubectl drain node/gpu-az15-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
will stagger 3 nodes per cohort, ~12m per node including boot.

jorge: canaries will run 2 requests/sec load for 10m, check tail P95/P99, kv-cache hitrate, and nvlink errors (dmesg). I'll post results in this thread.

priya: I'll draft customer comms and update the status page. post-comms: we'll include ETA, affected pools, and fallback routing. SLA owners — if we see >1% error lift for 5m we escalate. :white_check_mark:

lee: ops runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az15-maint|runbook/az15-maint>. rollback conditions (quick):
1) >2% sustained tail-latency increase (5m)
2) >0.5% error-rate increase (5m)
3) canaries fail nvlink/egress checks
if any hit, pause and roll back cohort.

sam: cost/capacity note — avoid full cold caches. do staggered drains so model kv caches stay warm where possible. reduce batch size for 30m after each cohort to reduce burst latency. set temporary qps throttle to 90% for az15 to push load to az12/az2. also we'll set pod eviction rate to slow: `--eviction-rate=0.3` in the drain helper script.

marta: checklist before T-1h:
- jorge: canary job created + smoke script validated
- priya: comms drafted and scheduled
- lee: runbook pinned and playbook ready
- sam: routing policy knobs prepared
I'll start the window at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z unless anyone objects. pls ack. :heavy_check_mark:

oncall-bot: maintenance ticket created: #9876 — scheduled 2026-03-21T02:00Z. participants: marta, jorge, sam, priya, lee.

priya: comms posted to status page and notified the priority customers list. ping me if any last-minute changes.

jorge: quick note — we'll enable extra traces for the first cohort (x-request-id + gpu-util) and add an alert if nvlink errors >0 for 1 node. I'll post canary results here ~T+20m.

marta: acked. thanks all — let's keep channel for live updates during the window, please post small concise updates (node id, step, result). :rocket:
